description.en: Croatia, officially the Republic of Croatia, is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe, on the coast of the Adriatic Sea. It borders Slovenia to the northwest, Hungary to the northeast, Serbia to the east, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Montenegro to the southeast, and shares a maritime border with Italy to the west.
description.zh-CN: 克羅埃西亞共和國，通稱克羅埃西亞，是位於東歐、地中海和中歐交會處的單一議會共和制國家，首都與最大城市為萨格勒布。克國將行政區劃分為20個縣與一個直轄市兼首都的萨格勒布，其領土面積為56,538平方公里。
